subject: MAP: GCP Private Offer — Commitment roadmap, billing lane & procurement sprint
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@meditrek.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditrek.com
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask — GCP private offer MAP and billing path

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency profiles and the billing controls you showed. Procurement asked me to get a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the milestones we need to deliver to get a GCP private offer in place (PO, acceptance testing, invoice cadence, and who signs what). We also need clarity on the billing lane (monthly invoice vs. committed spend, any holdback) and a sample invoice cadence for our finance team.

Can you send a MAP and suggested procurement timeline? Targeting a PO in the first week of September if we can meet legal/finance checkpoints.

Attaching our internal procurement checklist separately.

Best,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of AI Platforms
Meditrek Health

Attachment: meditrek_procurement_checklist_v2.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@meditrek.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@gcp-partner.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2029 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer MAP and billing path

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and glad the demo landed. I put together a concise MAP and a recommended billing lane that matches typical GCP private offer flows + Redwood contract terms. See attached: "Meditrek_MAP_v1.xlsx" (MAP with milestones and owners) and a short PDF showing invoice cadence examples. High level summary below: 

- Week 0 (today): Legal & Procurement kickoff — share Redwood standard PO language and billing contacts. Owner: Meditrek procurement.
- Week 1: Technical acceptance criteria & test plan sign-off (we provide a 3-day live acceptance window on a dedicated instance). Owner: Meditrek eng + Redwood SRE.
- Week 2: Finalize private offer terms in partner console and share invoice template. Owner: Redwood BizOps + GCP partner.
- Week 3: PO submission from Meditrek, signature from Redwood commercial.
- Week 4: Invoice issuance and first pro-rated invoice or month-one invoice per agreed cadence.

Billing lane options (pick one): monthly invoiced spend (standard), committed monthly minimum with true-up, or prepaid commit (credit). We recommend monthly invoiced spend with a Net-30 term for speed; if procurement insists on commit, see MAP for staged commit with a 3-month true-up.

Open items: 1) Meditrek legal redlines to Redwood T&Cs, 2) finance ask re: tax and invoicing address, 3) whether you need an SLA attachment on the PO.

Next steps I propose: 1) Review MAP (attached) and confirm owners, 2) we set a 30-minute procurement handshake next week to align on PO text and invoice sample.

I'll loop Ben for any special billing exceptions and Marcus for partner/GCP console steps.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Sr. Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Meditrek_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx stub), invoice_cadence_playbook.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@meditrek.com>, procurement@meditrek.com
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer MAP and billing path

Adding quick notes from finance perspective:

- We can support Net-30 monthly invoices; to speed close I recommend starting Net-30 and avoid an initial committed minimum unless Meditrek needs committed discounts.
- If they want a committed discount, propose a staged commit: Month 1 trial, Month 2 commit at X, Month 3 true-up; finance will require a contract clause for true-up and invoice adjustments.
- Tax/invoice address: we'll need the legal entity name and remit-to address from procurement before final invoice.

I'll prepare a short invoice template we can share in the procurement meeting. Marcus — can you call out any console steps for creating the private offer and expected timeline?

Thanks,
Ben
Principal, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@meditrek.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditrek.com, Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@gcp-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2029 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer MAP and billing path

Hi all — small note on partner/GCP steps so expectations are clear: 

- Private offer creation in GCP partner console: once commercial terms are set it takes ~48 hours to propagate and another 24–48 hours for acceptance flow to be visible to the buyer (Meditrek).
- DocuSign/PO: We can sign commercial SOW and then create the private offer. If procurement wants the PO first, we can accept PO and then issue the private offer within the 48 hour window.
- SLA attachment: Redwood can include our standard SLA as an addendum; we can also provide a short availability attachment (30/60/99.9 targets) if they need it for their GRC review.

I added two suggested owners in the MAP spreadsheet for partner console steps and created a short playbook entry in the invoice_cadence_playbook.pdf for the expected invoice timing.

Marcus
Partner Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@meditrek.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meditrek.com, Tina Ramos <tina.ramos@gcp-partner.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2029 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask — GCP private offer MAP and billing path

Soojin / team — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick confirmations from procurement:

1) We will proceed with Net-30 monthly invoicing for speed (no initial commit).
2) Our legal will send a short redline to Redwood T&Cs by EOD Wednesday.
3) Procurement would like the invoice template and an example first-month pro-rated invoice so our AP team can configure the vendor profile.

Let's lock a 30-minute procurement handshake on Thursday 10:00 AM PT. Can Redwood send the DocuSign once legal confirms? If so, we can aim to have a signed PO and private offer live within the two-week window.

Thanks again — Alex
Alex Chen
Head of AI Platforms
Meditrek Health
